from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Title and Lecture Lines
        title_text = "Prerequisite: The Reynolds Number (Re)"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Reynolds number compares inertial forces to viscous forces.",
            "High inertia creates the violent, chaotic wake.",
            "Viscosity tries to dampen the fluid's motion."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Colors
        INERTIA_COLOR = "#808080"
        VISCOSITY_COLOR = "#0000FF"
        FORMULA_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = YELLOW

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.play(self.lecture[0].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR))

        # Display the formula Re = uL/nu
        formula = MathTex(r"Re = \frac{uL}{\nu}", color=FORMULA_COLOR)
        # Place formula in the top area of the grid
        self.place_in_area(formula, "A2", "B5", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Transition highlight
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        )

        # Create Scale components
        # Pivot (Static)
        pivot = Triangle(color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1)
        self.place_at_grid(pivot, "E3", scale_factor=0.2)
        pivot_top = pivot.get_top()

        # Beam (Persistent)
        beam = Line(LEFT * 1.6, RIGHT * 1.6, color=WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        beam.move_to(pivot_top)

        # Inertia weight (Persistent)
        inertia_box = Square(side_length=0.7, color=INERTIA_COLOR, fill_opacity=1)
        inertia_label = Text("Inertia", font_size=14, color=BLACK)
        inertia_weight = VGroup(inertia_box, inertia_label)
        
        # Initial position: High up on the grid
        self.place_at_grid(inertia_weight, "B2", scale_factor=1.0)
        # Target position: Resting on the left side of the beam
        target_pos_inertia = pivot_top + LEFT * 1.2 + UP * 0.35

        self.play(Create(pivot), Create(beam))
        self.play(inertia_weight.animate.move_to(target_pos_inertia))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Transition highlight
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        )

        # Viscosity drop (Persistent)
        viscosity_dot = Dot(radius=0.15, color=VISCOSITY_COLOR)
        viscosity_label = Text("Viscosity", font_size=14, color=VISCOSITY_COLOR)
        viscosity_item = VGroup(viscosity_dot, viscosity_label).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        
        # Initial position: High up on the grid
        self.place_at_grid(viscosity_item, "B5", scale_factor=1.0)
        # Target position: Resting on the right side of the beam
        target_pos_viscosity = pivot_top + RIGHT * 1.2 + UP * 0.15

        self.play(viscosity_item.animate.move_to(target_pos_viscosity))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # Scale tips: Inertia (left) goes down, Viscosity (right) goes up.
        # Group objects for simultaneous rotation
        scale_on_beam = VGroup(beam, inertia_weight, viscosity_item)
        
        # tip_angle positive rotates CCW around pivot_top, 
        # which moves the left side (inertia) DOWN and right side (viscosity) UP.
        tip_angle = 20 * DEGREES
        
        self.play(
            Rotate(scale_on_beam, angle=tip_angle, about_point=pivot_top),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        self.wait(2)

        # Final cleanup: Reset highlight
        self.play(self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(1)
